newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORNE OIL ON SCHEDULE FOR SEPT - STATOIL.
newsitem.headline: NORNE OIL ON SCHEDULE FOR SEPT - STATOIL.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday development of the new Norne field off mid-Norway was on course for oil to begin circulating through the systems on schedule in mid-September.
Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said mooring of the Norne production ship, tie-in of the subsea installations and piping systems and testing had been completed as planned.
"This means we have finished the most critical operations in readying Norne for production," Rolf Saltkjel, manager of the project, was quoted as saying.
"This is the first time Statoil has moored a production ship with such heavyweight anchoring systems and we've completed a field development in 380 metres of water without diver assistance."
